O país escolhe a moeda, a taxa de câmbio: The country sets the currency, the exchange rate and the reference data the estimate uses, such as teacher salaries, inflation and schools with internet. Without a country, the tool's illustrative values apply. You can change any value later.
É quem decide a compra e paga por ela: m: This is who decides on the purchase and pays for it: a ministry, a state or local education department, a district or a group of schools. The level sets which procurement rules apply and which budget the money comes from. If more than one level is involved, choose the one that signs the contract.
O nome da rede ou do lugar identifica o: The name of the system or place identifies the case in the procurement plan and in the PDF. It does not change the cost. Use the name your team and suppliers will recognise.
Diz em que momento da compra a rede está: This says where the system is in the purchase. It changes the order of the plan's recommendations: someone who only wants to estimate the budget gets different actions from someone who already has a supplier's proposal. It does not change the cost.
As etapas de ensino dizem quem pode ser: The levels of education say who can be served and how many students are counted. Tick only the levels where the tool will be used, even if the system serves others.
A prioridade é o grande objetivo da rede: The priority is the system's main goal for AI in education. It filters the problems in the next question and guides the tasks suggested later on. You can tick more than one; the button on each card shows examples.
São os problemas concretos que a rede qu: These are the concrete problems the system wants to solve, without talking about technology. Each problem you tick comes with a written objective and suggests answers for the next questions, such as the description, the impact and the tasks. Tick only the ones that matter now.
Uma frase curta que resume o problema, c: A short sentence that sums up the problem, the way the team would put it in a meeting. It becomes the case title in the plan if you give no other name. It does not change the cost.
Descreva a situação de hoje: quem é afet: Describe the situation today: who is affected, where, and what is known about the causes. A good description still makes sense without the word AI. It is what justifies the purchase in the plan and guides what to measure later.
O impacto é a mudança que a rede quer ve: The impact is the change the system wants to see in schools, such as more learning or fewer dropouts. It guides the tasks suggested in step 2.1 and what to measure in the pilot.
Diga quanto quer mudar e em quanto tempo: Say how much you want to change and by when, with the indicator you will use. A result with a number helps you decide later whether the tool was worth the cost.
Antes de comprar IA, vale comparar com u: Before buying AI, it is worth comparing it with a solution without AI, such as tutoring or ordinary software. If the alternative solves the problem for less, the plan recommends considering it. The answer "Not yet" adds an action to the plan.
Uma equipe com pedagogia, tecnologia, ju: A team with teaching, technology, legal, procurement and data protection staff decides on and follows the use of AI. Without it, decisions are scattered and risks grow. The team's time counts in the governance cost, layer 1.
A política diz para que a IA pode ser us: The policy says what AI may be used for, by whom and with what responsibilities. It guides the terms of reference and the contracts. Without it, the plan recommends writing one before scaling up.
Leis de proteção de dados, regras sobre: Data protection laws, AI rules, the rights of children and adolescents and public procurement rules all apply to AI in schools. Knowing them beforehand avoids contracts that have to be redone.
A política de dados diz quem pode acessa: The data policy says who may access, keep, share and delete data about students and staff. AI tools usually process this data; without rules, the contract has no basis for its protection clauses.
Orientações de uso responsável dizem a p: Responsible-use guidance tells teachers, students and school leaders what is allowed and what to do when in doubt. It reduces incidents and becomes part of staff training.
Regras de contratação de IA pedem, por e: AI procurement rules ask, for example, for the cost of use over several years and for data and exit clauses. Without them, each purchase starts from scratch. This tool's plan helps you put that content together.
Um nome curto para a aplicação, que apar: A short name for the application, shown in the plan and in the PDF. If you leave it blank, the tool uses the name of the first task. It does not change the cost.
São as pessoas que vão abrir e usar a fe: These are the people who will open and use the tool. Who uses it sets how many licences, how much training and how much support are needed, so it weighs on the cost. The tasks in step 2.1 suggest an answer.
São as pessoas que recebem o que a ferra: These are the people who receive what the tool produces, even without using it, such as students who receive activities. When children are affected, the plan asks for more care with data and with how errors can be challenged.
Diz o que se faz com a resposta da IA. U: This says what is done with the AI's answer. Using it as support is different from grading or deciding who gets help first. The more the answer decides about people, the more human review, monitoring and care the plan asks for.
Se você já sabe quais ferramentas vai us: If you already know which tools you will use, you can list them with name and price, and the estimate gets closer to reality. If you do not know yet, answer "Not yet": the estimate uses illustrative prices.
Informe quantas escolas já têm conexão b: Enter how many schools already have a connection good enough for a whole class to use the tool. The others are counted with a yearly connection fee. Without the number, the estimate assumes half of the schools.
Marque quem precisa aprender a usar a fe: Tick who needs to learn to use the tool: the people who use it every day and those who support them, such as school leaders and technical staff. Each group trained adds training hours to the cost.
Diz o que a formação vai ensinar: usar a: This says what the training will cover: using the technology, using it in class, running the pilot or protecting data. Each type goes into the training programme and into what to buy from the supplier.
Presencial custa mais por pessoa, com de: In-person training costs more per person, with travel, trainers and venues; online costs less but usually comes with less follow-up. The format changes the cost of the training programme.
Diz quem atende as dúvidas e os problema: This says who answers schools' questions and problems. If it is the supplier, support is usually part of the contract; if it is the system, it takes staff time. Both together is common.
É quantos anos a rede leva, depois da pr: This is how many years the system takes, after the first stage, to reach everyone in question 4.1.1. Scaling faster raises the cost of the first years; scaling more slowly spreads the cost over time.
Diz como o número de pessoas que usam cr: This says how the number of people using the tool grows each year until it reaches the whole system. Linear rises in equal steps; S-shaped starts slowly; in waves follows the years you enter.
Informe em que ano a rede chega a cada p: Enter the year in which the system reaches each percentage of all the people. For example: Year 2, 50%; Year 4, 100%. Each year's cost follows these waves.
Dispositivos duram alguns anos e precisa: Devices last a few years and then need replacing. If the system buys devices in step 2.4, replacement enters the recurring cost at each cycle. Without an answer, the estimate does not replace them.
Todo ano parte das pessoas formadas sai: Every year some of the trained people leave the system, and newcomers need training. Enter the yearly percentage; without it, the estimate uses 10% a year.
Oferecida por um governo ou por uma inst: Provided by a government or a public institution, with no licence price for the system. There are still training, support and integration costs.
O código ou o modelo é aberto e pode ser: The code or the model is open and can be installed by the system or by a contracted company. There is no licence, but there are cloud, operation and security costs.
Um produto ou serviço vendido por uma em: A product or service sold by a company, usually by subscription. The licence price is usually the largest part of the visible cost.
Um valor por pessoa que usa, em geral po: An amount for each person who uses the tool, usually per month. The cost grows with the number of users.
Um valor fixo para a rede toda, em geral: A fixed amount for the whole system, usually per year, no matter how many people use it.
Paga-se pelo uso, por exemplo por chamad: You pay for use, for example per call to the model or per million tokens. The cost goes up and down with how intensively it is used.
A ferramenta já vem numa plataforma que: The tool already comes in a platform the system pays for, such as an office suite. There is no new price, but there may be usage limits.
O fornecedor ou um parceiro oferece a fe: The supplier or a partner offers the tool free of charge for a while. Ask how much it will cost after the free period.
A rede paga para usar por um prazo, em g: The system pays to use the tool for a period, usually a year. At the end of the period, it renews or loses access.
A rede pode usar, modificar e hospedar a: The system may use, modify and host the tool wherever it wants, without paying a licence. It needs a team or a company to run it.
Os termos aceitos ao criar uma conta, ig: The terms accepted when creating an account, the same for everyone and not negotiated. They usually give few guarantees on data and on exit.
Só criar contas, turmas e permissões. É: Only creating accounts, classes and permissions. This is the cheapest level.
Traduzir, ajustar ao currículo e usar ex: Translating, aligning with the curriculum and using local examples. It takes time from content specialists.
Ligar a ferramenta ao login, à matrícula: Connecting the tool to the system's login, enrolment or learning platform. It takes technical staff and maintenance.
Programar funções novas ou uma aplicação: Programming new features or the system's own application. This is the most expensive level and the one that needs the most maintenance.
Soma o custo de todos os anos, do teste: Adds up the cost of every year, from the test (Year 0) to the last year of the horizon: licences, internet, devices, training, support and staff time, not just the purchase price. It is in Year 0 prices, discounted. It changes with every answer.
A estimativa é refeita com muitas combin: The estimate is recalculated with many combinations of assumptions. In 8 out of 10 scenarios, the total cost falls between the two values; this is the P10–P90 range. A wide range shows it is worth getting quotes and local data before deciding.
O Ano 0 é o ano do teste: a prova de con: Year 0 is the test year: the proof of concept, the pilot or both. It is what the system spends before deciding to buy for real.
Quanto a rede gasta por ano quando o uso: How much the system spends per year once use has reached the planned scale. It is the amount the budget has to set aside every year to keep the tool, after the start-up costs.
A linha d'água separa o que aparece no p: The waterline separates what appears in the proposal price, such as licences and devices, from what lies below it: staff time, training, support and governance. The part below often weighs more.
Divide o custo total pelas fases do caso: Splits the total cost by the phases of the case: test (Year 0), roll-out (Year 1) and scale-up. The bar for each phase shows how much is visible in the price and how much lies below the waterline.
São as premissas que mais mexem no custo: These are the assumptions that move the total cost the most. For each one, the estimate swaps the value for the lowest and the highest in its range and measures how much the total changes. Start with them when you look for quotes.
Explica em frases simples o que mais pes: Explains in simple sentences what weighs most on the amount: the phase where the cost is concentrated and the assumptions that make it vary most.
Mostra quanto o custo total mudou com a: Shows how much the total cost changed with your last answer and which question it came from. That way you see the effect of each choice.
Os preços e as quantidades de partida sã: The starting prices and quantities are the tool's examples, not quotes from your system. Replace them with local data in the assumptions panel to get a real estimate.
Premissas são os números que a estimativ: Assumptions are the numbers the estimate uses: prices, salaries, quantities. Each one shows where it came from; values without a source are illustrative.
Resume, com as suas respostas, o que faz: Sums up, from your answers, what to do first: the kind of test, its size and the first stage of the roll-out.
As próximas ações para este caso, das de: The next actions for this case, from high to medium priority. Each one comes from your answers; use "Go to the question" to change what triggered it.
Este número é o que a estimativa usa enq: This number is what the estimate uses until you enter your own. It comes from the tool's assumptions or from other answers, and the cost panel already includes it. Type your system's number to replace it.
O resumo do plano numa página: o que se: The plan summed up on one page: what is proposed, why, the main figures and the actions that come first. This is the part to take to decision-makers.
Mostra o que a rede vai contratar e para: Shows what the system will buy and for how many people: the kind of test, the tool and the purchasing arrangement. It is the basis of the terms of reference.
Mostra quanto o caso custa em cada fase: Shows how much the case costs in each phase and which part repeats every year. The recurring cost is what the budget has to guarantee once the test is over.
Mostra a faixa provável do custo e as pr: Shows the likely cost range and the assumptions that make it vary most. Use it to know what to confirm before asking for the budget.
Lista as cláusulas e os requisitos de cu: Lists the cost and purchasing clauses and requirements, including how much leaving the contract would cost. Take this part to the procurement team and to legal advisers.
Mostra que condições de governança a red: Shows which governance conditions the system already has and what is missing: team, rules, data and monitoring. What is missing becomes an action in the plan.
Os anexos guardam os detalhes: respostas: The annexes hold the details: answers, calculation, clauses, assumptions, glossary and references. Open only what you need to look up.
Todas as respostas do caso, como foram d: All the answers in the case, as they were given, to check before sharing the plan.
O que cada fase do caso exige em cada um: What each phase of the case requires in each of the seven layers of the total cost.
Todas as recomendações para o caso, orga: All the recommendations for the case, organised by when they should be carried out.
Como a ferramenta chega ao número: a fór: How the tool reaches the figure: the formula, the estimated cost per year and the seven-layer checklist to compare with quotes.
Requisitos e cláusulas para levar ao ter: Requirements and clauses to take into the terms of reference and the contract, and the documents the purchase file needs.
A governança em detalhe: capacidade míni: Governance in detail: minimum capacity in schools, risk profile, what to do before taking it to the system, metrics and decision criteria.
Cada premissa da estimativa com a fonte,: Each assumption in the estimate with its source, its year and whether it is illustrative. Replace the illustrative ones with local data.
Os termos técnicos do plano explicados e: The plan's technical terms explained in plain language.
Os documentos de referência usados pela: The reference documents used by the tool and the figure credits.
Valor ilustrativo, usado até você inform: Illustrative value, used until you enter yours
